name: Paying The Tithe adds charges to Seraphic Bulwark and crit to Dawnbreak (#1008)
contract: Paying The Tithe 681468 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) carries two SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects. Effect 0: EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CHARGES (4), EffectSpellClassMask word A = 256 (bit 8), EffectBasePoints 3 resolving to +4. Seraphic Bulwark 560095 carries SpellFamilyFlags word A = 256 (the same bit) and its own ProcCharges = 5, and Aura::CalcMaxAuraStacks-equivalent charge setup (SpellAuras.cpp) calls modOwner->ApplySpellMod(GetId(), SPELLMOD_CHARGES, maxProcCharges) using the aura's own spell id, so this raises Seraphic Bulwark's charges from 5 to 9. Effect 1: EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (7), EffectSpellClassMask word B = 1073741824 (bit 30), EffectBasePoints 19 resolving to +20. Every Dawnbreak rank (e.g. rank 1, spell 800654) carries SpellFamilyFlags word B = 1073741824, the same bit, so SpellInfo::IsAffected(33, mask) admits it and Player::ApplySpellMod adds +20 crit chance with no script. This scenario drives both native calls through the harness's spell_modifier metric.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Seraphic Bulwark keeps its native 5 charges before the talent
Dawnbreak crit chance modifier is zero before the talent
Paying The Tithe raises Seraphic Bulwark to 9 charges
Paying The Tithe adds 20 to Dawnbreak's crit chance
